Good morning. Today is August 18th. I’m – this is the second day of recording the oral history of Mr. Jon Hendricks, the poet laureate of jazz, a wonderful lyricist, composer, and singer, and just a humanitarian. He’s a wonderful guy. We’re in the National Portrait Gallery of the Smithsonian Institution. My name is James Zimmerman. Good morning, Jon.
